property_summary: A TimelockController/AccessControl contract that advertises ERC165 (supportsInterface(type(IERC165).interfaceId) is true) must also advertise the IAccessControl interface id, since AccessControl supports both; the mutant drops the IAccessControl check, so it reports true for ERC165 but false for IAccessControl.
change_summary: Remove the IAccessControl check so only ERC165's interface id (and any super overrides) is supported.
